_note: Canonical shape every `evaluate:` step returns. Engine-owned and enforced by `evaluatorResultSchema` in src/engine/engine.ts — this file is documentation, not a loaded schema. Copy the `fields` into a spec's `contracts:` map (as a contract like `Eval`) when you want to reference an evaluate step's output; the engine validates the data against its own strict schema regardless of what a spec declares.

fields.status: one of closed | open | failed. closed = goal discharged; open = work remains (carries children); failed = the attempt did not work (a verdict, not an engine error).
fields.children: array of newly-discovered sub-work items. MUST be empty when status is closed; MUST be non-empty when status is open. The fan-out source for S2.
fields.route: optional claude | codex; lets the evaluator pick the agent for follow-up work. Feeds S4.

invariants: status closed implies children is empty
status open implies children is non-empty
a transport failure (non-zero exit, timeout, unparseable output) is NEVER reported as closed — it is a distinct typed engine failure
